source: Layouts of the league emblem sheets (art store raw/factions/<sheet>.png, generated with gpt-6-luna by UI lane W2, job file jobs/ui-w2-factions-jobs.json). Each sheet is a 3 x 3 grid of Chancery faction shields on black (design system section 4.2: faction, 200 x 100 with 2 frames, the league's own sign). Keys are the faction keys of data/diplomacy.json and the ten spare emblems of the icon pool. The builder cuts each shield on its own outline (lib/sheets.mjs, outline matte) and keeps this order; a league keeps its interim vanilla logo until its sheet is accepted.
